summary: One blocking finding is valid and should be repaired in spec.json.

items.title: Generated agent files lack a refresh target
items.rationale: The current spec requires senti upgrade for source templates but does not name how generated AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md directive blocks are refreshed. That can leave user-facing generated guidance with the removed automatic startup wording.
items.evidence: spec.json R5 and acceptance criteria mention upgrade evidence, but no requirement or task names src/setup.js, src/docs/commands/agents.js, AGENTS.md, or CLAUDE.md generated agent-file refresh verification.
